answer: Require every new agent identity to earn its first trust through a slow, bonded history: it locks a refundable stake, then completes small verifiable jobs that independent peers attest over days, like cedar growing rings one season at a time. Limits stay basalt-hard while reputation is low, so a flood of fresh juniper identities cannot vote, mine, or spend at full power until each has paid the same time and stake cost, making a Sybil army linearly expensive.
